hero.title:
DreamPalm

Smart Solution for

Oil Palm

Health Detection
hero.description: Integrating multispectral drones with real-time AI processing via a web dashboard to accurately predict tree health status. This enables responsive spot-spraying operations without the need to land the fleet.

about.title:
Digital Agriculture for

the Future of Oil Palm
about.description1: Oil palms frequently encounter health issues that have the potential to significantly reduce plantation productivity. Dreampalm is designed as an integrated agricultural drone system that combines aerial monitoring capabilities with artificial intelligence to differentiate between healthy and unhealthy palms directly in the field.
about.description2: Unlike conventional maintenance methods that rely on blanket chemical spraying across the entire plantation, the Dreampalm system enables a precision spot-treatment approach. It automatically maps areas containing unhealthy palms and applies sprays only where necessary, significantly reducing operational costs while preserving the plantation's environmental sustainability.

research.imageCaption: UAV Drone Platform · Multispectral Module & RC Spraying
research.title:
High-Performance

Hardware Architecture
research.description: The Dreampalm drone is specifically engineered to integrate a reliable propulsion system, edge computing, and precision spraying mechanisms into a unified system.

specs.valDriver: Utilizes an 8-rotor configuration to ensure high flight stability and resistance to strong winds while operating over plantations.
specs.valSensor: Advanced 5-band multispectral camera that captures specialized light spectra to detect hidden leaf health conditions invisible to the naked eye.
specs.valAi: On-board mini-computer responsible for managing automated flight stability while processing artificial intelligence tasks in real-time.
specs.valNavigation: High-precision location tracking module enabling the system to accurately lock onto tree coordinates without deviation, supported by a radio transmitter for long-range data communication.
specs.valSpray: Metered electric pump with specialized nozzle sets to apply treatment liquids precisely to targeted plant spots.

classification.title: Multispectral AI Classification
classification.body: Utilizes a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model that processes Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) values and 5 light spectra to differentiate between healthy and unhealthy plants with up to 95.38% accuracy.

monitoring.title: Web Monitoring & Live Snapshot
monitoring.body: A low-latency interactive dashboard enables operators to monitor telemetry data and GPS positions, as well as trigger instant image captures directly from the web interface while the drone is hovering.

mapping.title: Responsive Spot-Spraying
mapping.body: Upon confirming an 'Unhealthy' status on the dashboard, precision spot-spraying can be triggered immediately at the target location via high-power pump actuators, without the need to land the fleet.
